title: Caesars Sportsbook Powers New Era of Betting at Westgate SuperBook
summary: Expanded wagering options, upgraded mobile capabilities and more than 20 self-service betting kiosks are now live at Las Vegas' iconic SuperBook ahead of football season LAS VEGAS (July 28, 2026) Caesars Entertainment, Inc. (NASDAQ: CZR) ("Caesars") and Westgate Las Vegas Resort Casino today announced that the Westgate SuperBook, powered by Caesars Sportsbook, is now live with new wagering capabilities ahead of football season, bringing together the legendary SuperBook experience and the modern sports betting features today's sports fans expect. Guests can now access expanded betting options, upgraded mobile wagering capabilities and more than 20 self-service wagering kiosks located throughout the SuperBook and Westgate Las Vegas Resort Casino. While the technology behind the SuperBook has evolved, it remains the iconic sports viewing and wagering destination that fans have known and loved for decades.
